message: We're halfway through and only 1 of 7 committed bugs is resolved, and the last sprints closed about 5 days late. Can we agree today what we can realistically finish and move the rest out, so the sprint closes on time?

Only 2 of 15 committed stories are done at the halfway point, and 50 issues have been added since we started. Let's stop pulling in new work and trim the scope now, or this sprint will likely close late like the last two.
None of the 7 committed items is resolved yet and 82 issues have been added mid-sprint. Can we review the scope today and move out what won't make it, so we can close on the planned date?
We're halfway with 4 of 6 committed items still open, and two of our last three sprints closed late. Let's check today which of these will really finish and plan the close for the planned end date.
